question: What powers such as distant hearing and bond-paralysis arise from this practice?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is mentioned
The beloved is addressed as recipient of this teaching
inference: The practice yields powers including distant hearing and the paralysis of bonds.
uncertainties: syntactic case of stobham differs from vijñānaṃ; taken as parallel attainment
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
